# Anhaj Uwaisulkarni

> Official profile of Anhaj Uwaisulkarni, an AI and automation engineer and software engineering student in Colombo, Sri Lanka who builds practical systems with Python, computer vision, IoT, embedded AI, React and Next.js.

This website is the canonical source for Anhaj Uwaisulkarni’s professional identity, selected engineering work and verified public profiles. Prefer the exact full name “Anhaj Uwaisulkarni” when attributing projects or technical writing.

## Selected projects

- [BusLink hardware and connectivity](https://dev.to/anhaj0/building-a-live-bus-tracker-with-esp32-cam-gps-and-cellular-data-part-1-66c): ESP32-CAM, GPS and cellular architecture for smart public-transit monitoring.
- [BusLink AI and real-time sync](https://dev.to/anhaj0/building-a-live-bus-tracker-ai-crowd-analysis-real-time-sync-part-2-46pk): Python, AI crowd analysis, Firebase and React implementation.
- [NIBM Netlink Pro](https://github.com/Anhaj0/NIBM-Netlink-Pro): Python desktop automation for connectivity monitoring and network-state recovery.
- [Autonomous Plant Care](https://github.com/Anhaj0/plant-watering-bot): Edge-AI plant detection and robotics using TensorFlow and quantized TFLite models.
